skill.name: compliance-checker
skill.description: Review code and processes against common security and privacy compliance standards.
skill.summary: Assess code for OWASP, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, and secure coding gaps.
skill.author: CuriousLearner

content.value_statement: Security teams need clear checks against many standards without rewriting each checklist. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured compliance reviews and gap reports.
actual_capabilities: Reviews applications against OWASP Top 10 categories.
Maps findings to PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, and other control areas.
Produces gap analysis with severity, affected standards, and remediation phases.
Checks secure coding topics such as injection, cryptography, access control, and logging.
Suggests evidence and documentation needed for compliance reviews.
Formats results as an executive summary plus technical remediation plan.
limitations: Does not replace a certified compliance audit or legal review.
Depends on the files, architecture notes, and evidence provided to the assistant.
Cannot guarantee full regulatory compliance from code inspection alone.
May need human validation for compensating controls and business context.

use_cases.title: Prepare an OWASP gap review
use_cases.description: Review a web application against OWASP Top 10 and identify missing safeguards before release.

use_cases.title: Check privacy control readiness
use_cases.description: Assess data handling, retention, consent, and user rights workflows against GDPR or CCPA expectations.

use_cases.title: Create remediation plans for audits
use_cases.description: Convert compliance gaps into prioritized fixes with owners, severity, and suggested timelines.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic compliance check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small codebase.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use compliance-checker to review this project for OWASP Top 10 risks. Summarize the top gaps and the first three fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on one standard
prompt_templates.prompt: Use compliance-checker with the HIPAA standard. Review the patient data flows and list gaps in access control, audit logging, and transmission security.

prompt_templates.title: Compare multiple standards
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare for a cross-functional compliance review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use compliance-checker to compare this service against OWASP, SOC 2, and GDPR. Group findings by shared remediation work.

prompt_templates.title: Build an executive remediation plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced report for leadership and engineering teams.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use compliance-checker to produce an executive compliance report with risk scores, evidence gaps, affected controls, and a 30-60-90 day remediation plan.

output_examples.input: Review an API for OWASP Top 10 compliance.
output: Top gap: Broken access control on protected resources.
Recommended next step: Add object-level authorization checks and regression tests.

output_examples.input: Assess a healthcare portal for HIPAA readiness.
output: Audit logging is present but PHI appears in some log events.
Priority fix: Log record identifiers instead of diagnosis or patient names.
Data subject rights need stronger coverage.
Right to erasure and portability are missing or partial.
Plan: implement deletion workflow, export workflow, and retention evidence.

best_practices: Provide architecture notes, data flow diagrams, and deployment context with the code review request.
Ask for one compliance standard at a time when evidence is limited.
Validate each finding with system owners before treating it as audit evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated reports as legal advice or certification proof.
Do not scan only source code when policies, logs, and cloud settings control compliance.
Do not ignore low-severity gaps that can combine into a larger audit failure.

faq.question: Which standards does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, CWE, SANS, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, CCPA, FERPA, NIST, and ISO 27001 topics.

faq.question: Can this skill certify my product as compliant?
faq.answer: No. It helps identify gaps and prepare evidence, but certification requires qualified auditors and organization-specific review.

faq.question: Does it run security scanners automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides analysis instructions, checklists, examples, and report structure for an assistant-led review.

faq.question: Can it review regulated data workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review handling of PHI, cardholder data, personal data, retention, access, logging, and user rights based on provided evidence.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide relevant code, routes, data models, logging samples, policies, deployment notes, and the target compliance standard.

faq.question: Is it useful before a formal audit?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help prepare a gap report, prioritize remediation, and organize evidence before a formal compliance assessment.
